paper.title_en: Exploring the phase diagram of dense and hot matter with HBT interferometry
paper.abstract_en: We investigate the HBT radii of pions produced in Au+Au collisions at selected energies from the STAR-BES program, using an event-by-event hybrid model that combines AMPT initial conditions, 3+1D viscous hydrodynamic evolution with a QCD equation of state at finite baryon chemical potential, and hadronic transport with SMASH. The goal is to explore the source's space-time structure and its possible connection to the structure of the QCD phase diagram. The hybrid chain was first validated by comparing identified-particle spectra and anisotropic flow, yielding a globally consistent description of the experimental data, with more evident discrepancies at the lowest energies.
